collection.description: A funny song about the broken bridge demands it be fixed: rebuild it the old way, or combine new methods.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Someone wrote a funny song about the broken bridge over the stream, with a verse for everyone who has fallen in. The whole village sings it now, and the builders cannot avoid hearing it. (subject) wants to rebuild the bridge exactly as it was. (friend) has an idea to combine a rope bridge with stone footings. What should they do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: The old bridge is rebuilt in a week. It is fine. The next big storm knocks it down again, and the song gets a new verse about the builders. (subject) listens to it with great dignity.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: The rope-and-stone bridge takes a month. It sways and creaks and terrifies everyone for a week. It survives the next three storms. The song gets a final verse about the bridge that would not fall. (friend) asks for it to be sung at every feast.
